notes.title: Demo Update: Boss-Spawned Enemies Rebalanced
notes.content: [p][b]What’s new?[/b][/p][list][*][p]The [b]enemies spawned by the boss[/b] now have [b]reduced health[/b] and deal [b]slightly less damage[/b]. This should make the boss fight feel more balanced and enjoyable.[/p][/*][/list]
